import hashlib, zipfile, json, copy, stat

input_bytes = input_path.read_bytes()

    incoming_members = {i.filename: z.read(i) for i in z.infolist()}
proposal = json.loads(incoming_members["PROPOSAL.json"])
local_review = json.loads(incoming_members["CASE_REVIEW_108.json"])

print("\nCASE KEYS")
for c in proposal["completeCases"]:

print("\nALL 43 PROPOSED FIELD OPERATIONS")

    return {
        "time":s.get("time"),"round":s.get("numberedRoundId"),"clockBoundary":s.get("clockBoundary"),
        "actors":{a:{k:b.get(k) for k in ("hp","action","reaction","regularStart","nextRegularStart","movementSpent","conditions","currentSpeedFeet","coilingAppendage","helpEntitlements","actionReceipts")} for a,b in s["actors"].items()},
        "eventReceipts":s.get("eventReceipts"),"rngHistory":s.get("rngHistory")
    }

audit = []
def verify(label, condition, detail=None):
    audit.append({"id": f"S108-{len(audit)+1:03d}", "check":label,
                  "passed":bool(condition), **({"detail":detail} if detail is not None else {})})
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(label)

def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def val_at(obj, path):
    cur=obj
    for bit in path.split("/")[1:]:
        bit=bit.replace("~1","/").replace("~0","~")
        cur=cur[int(bit)] if isinstance(cur,list) else cur[bit]
    return cur

def edit_value(obj, path, op, new=None):
    bits=path.split("/")[1:]
    cur=obj
    for bit in bits[:-1]:
        bit=bit.replace("~1","/").replace("~0","~")
        cur=cur[int(bit)] if isinstance(cur,list) else cur[bit]
    key=bits[-1].replace("~1","/").replace("~0","~")
    if isinstance(cur,list):
        idx=int(key)
        if op=="add":
            assert idx==len(cur), (path,idx,len(cur))
            cur.insert(idx,copy.deepcopy(new))
        elif op=="remove":
            cur.pop(idx)
        else:
            cur[idx]=copy.deepcopy(new)
    elif op=="remove":
        del cur[key]
    else:
        if op=="add": assert key not in cur
        cur[key]=copy.deepcopy(new)

def all_states(case):
    yield "/initialState",case["initialState"]
    for ei,event in enumerate(case["timeline"]):
        yield f"/timeline/{ei}/before",event["before"]
        yield f"/timeline/{ei}/after",event["after"]
    yield "/finalState",case["finalState"]

def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def getp(obj,p):
    for k in p.split("/")[1:]:
        k=k.replace("~1","/").replace("~0","~")
        obj=obj[int(k)] if isinstance(obj,list) else obj[k]
    return obj
def setp(obj,p,value):
    ks=p.split("/")[1:]
    par=obj
    for k in ks[:-1]:
        k=k.replace("~1","/").replace("~0","~")
        par=par[int(k)] if isinstance(par,list) else par[k]
    k=ks[-1].replace("~1","/").replace("~0","~")
    if isinstance(par,list):par[int(k)]=copy.deepcopy(value)
    else:par[k]=copy.deepcopy(value)
def bind_bytes(b,name):return {"path":name,"bytes":len(b),"sha256":sha(b)}
def check_zip(zz,label):
    names=zz.namelist()
    check(label+" safe unique file members", len(names)==len(set(names)) and all(not PurePosixPath(n).is_absolute() and ".." not in PurePosixPath(n).parts and "\\" not in n and not n.endswith("/") for n in names))
    check(label+" CRC",zz.testzip() is None)
    m=json.loads(zz.read("MANIFEST.json"))
    for v in m["files"]:
        p=v.get("file",v.get("path"))
        data=zz.read(p)
        check(label+" bound "+p,len(data)==v["bytes"] and sha(data)==v["sha256"])
    return m

def encode_like(obj,raw):
    # Choose source serialization by exact match to the starting full object.
    for ensure in (False,True):
        for indent in (2,4,None):
            for trail in ("\n","\r\n",""):
                for eol in ("\n","\r\n"):
                    text=json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=ensure,indent=indent)
                    if eol=="\r\n": text=text.replace("\n","\r\n")
                    candidate=(text+trail).encode("utf-8")
                    if candidate==raw:
                        return lambda val, en=ensure, ind=indent, tr=trail, el=eol: (json.dumps(val,ensure_ascii=en,indent=ind).replace("\n",el)+tr).encode()
    return None

def walk(obj,p=""):
    yield p,obj
    if isinstance(obj,dict):
        for k,v in obj.items():
            yield from walk(v,p+"/"+k.replace("~","~0").replace("/","~1"))
    elif isinstance(obj,list):
        for i,v in enumerate(obj):yield from walk(v,p+f"/{i}")

 quick_ritualist For a spell you can actually cast through a legal ritual route, halve only the route’s additional ritual time, with resulting additional time at least 5 minutes; retain the base printed casting time in full. NEW measure the result in elapsed seconds and round up to the next whole second so fractions never shorten a required interval. An original 10 minute addition becomes 5 minutes, not half the whole cast. An original shorter addition is not increased: use min(original additional time, max(300, ceil(original/2))). This explicit non-worsening interpretation preserves the minimum for reductions without penalizing a preexisting faster route. Components, formula/repertoire, costs, concentration, helpers and interruptions remain. It grants no Ritual tag or access; the separate proposed Ritual Caster overlay needs its own approval. Apply this additional-time change before any separately legal group active-time adjustment, whose minimum rule remains.
NEW common ritual arithmetic: let B be the spell’s actual base casting labor and A its separately required added ritual labor, in whole seconds. Quick Ritualist changes A to min(A,max(300,ceil(A/2))), leaving B unchanged. This never lengthens an already shorter source procedure. Literal source-required elapsed waiting is not active labor to halve.

 ritual_channeler NEW a group ritual is one actual legally available ritual spell with a designated lead and at least one physically present willing assistant continuously performing that same ritual’s active work; it is not simultaneous crafting, travel or independent casts. Use the exact source’s assistant qualifications/cap. If it supplies none, the proposed default assistant must know that ritual or have proficiency in the lead’s actual relevant Arcana/Religion/Nature skill; count at most two ordinary assistant contributions, with no numeric roll bonus when the source has no assistant benefit. This feat-holder contributes as two ordinary assistants within that cap, never as two leads or two physical bodies for a separate location requirement. One or more holders reduce the group’s total active casting time once by 25%, rounding up seconds; passive waiting is unchanged. Apply after Quick Ritualist’s additional-time reduction, but never reduce that remaining additional ritual portion below 5 minutes unless it was already shorter. # Search parsed current data strings for a full source section rather than the empty field.
def walk_strings(x,path=""):
    if isinstance(x,dict):
        for k,v in x.items():
            yield from walk_strings(v,path+"/"+str(k).replace("~","~0").replace("/","~1"))
    elif isinstance(x,list):
        for i,v in enumerate(x): yield from walk_strings(v,path+"/"+str(i))
    elif isinstance(x,str): yield path,x

def ptr(obj, p):
    if p in ("","/"): return obj if p=="" else obj[""]
    for t in p.split("/")[1:]:
        t=t.replace("~1","/").replace("~0","~")
        obj=obj[int(t)] if isinstance(obj,list) else obj[t]
    return obj

def bound_ref(scope,member,pointer=None):
    pkg=npkg if scope=="N" else spkg
    name=NNAME if scope=="N" else SNAME
    ref={"outerArchive":outer_name,"outerSha256":H(blob),"nestedArchiveMember":name,
         "nestedArchiveSha256":H(outer[name]),"member":member,
         "bytes":len(pkg[member]),"sha256":H(pkg[member])}
    if pointer is not None: ref["pointer"]=pointer
    return ref

def jp(obj,p):
    if p=="":return obj
    for k in p.lstrip('/').split('/'):
        k=k.replace('~1','/').replace('~0','~')
        obj=obj[int(k)] if isinstance(obj,list) else obj[k]
    return obj
def esc(s):return str(s).replace('~','~0').replace('/','~1')
def walk(o,p=""):
    if isinstance(o,dict):
        for k,v in o.items():
            yield from walk(v,p+'/'+esc(k))
    elif isinstance(o,list):
        for i,v in enumerate(o):yield from walk(v,p+'/'+str(i))
    else:yield p,o

def diffs(a,b,p=''):
    out=[]
    if type(a)!=type(b):return [(p,'type',type(a).__name__,type(b).__name__)]
    if isinstance(a,dict):
        for k in a.keys()|b.keys():
            pp=p+'/'+esc(k)
            if k not in a:out.append((pp,'only-right',None,b[k]))
            elif k not in b:out.append((pp,'only-left',a[k],None))
            else:out.extend(diffs(a[k],b[k],pp))
    elif isinstance(a,list):
        if len(a)!=len(b):out.append((p,'length',len(a),len(b)))
        for i,(aa,bb) in enumerate(zip(a,b)):out.extend(diffs(aa,bb,p+'/'+str(i)))
    elif a!=b:out.append((p,'value',a,b))
    return out

def nodes(o):
    yield o
    if isinstance(o,dict):
        for v in o.values():yield from nodes(v)
    elif isinstance(o,list):
        for v in o:yield from nodes(v)
